items.title: 12.11 Uses of sulfur and its compounds (sulfur aur us ke compounds ke istemal) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to topic 12.11, printed page 283.

blocks.text: Sulfur aur is ke compounds industry aur rozmarra zindagi mein bohat kaam aate hain. Kitab is heading ke neeche teen istemal batati hai: rubber ki vulcanisation (12.11.1), fertilizer (12.11.2) aur gun powder (12.11.3). Sulfur ka sab se bara istemal sulfuric acid banana hai (12.13), aur drugs, dyes aur khushbuon (fragrances) mein is ka role (kirdar) 12.12 mein hai.

items: Sulfur ke istemal: vulcanisation, fertilizer, gun powder; sulfuric acid; drugs, dyes, fragrances.
